clips.title: The story
paras: At Three Corners, Watch Captain Parker guards the road and travelers bound for Lakeshire. He patrols the junction and watches the gnoll packs gathering nearby, an early line of defense for those heading into town.

At Three Corners, Watch Captain Parker watches the roads between Elwynn Forest, Duskwood, and Redridge. Stormwind has few troops to spare, and little official help reaches the region. Parker and other lone watchmen must keep the crossroads clear of bandits, prowling predators, and raiding gnolls.

Gnoll camps gathering north and east of Parker’s post draw his attention. As the packs press closer to the road, he sends able-bodied travelers to warn Deputy Feldon in Lakeshire. The Redridge gnolls grow bolder, threatening supply convoys and refugees seeking shelter in town.

A lonely roadside post can be grim, yet kindness reaches Three Corners. Darcy, a server at the Lakeshire Inn, sends Parker a warm lunch while he patrols. Touched by her kindness, Parker asks the traveler who brought it to fetch a bouquet from Lakeshire’s herbalist and take it back to Darcy. He asks that the herbalist not be told who the flowers are from or for.
